messages:
junaid_csm: Quick heads-up: Sablefield onboarding traffic spiked this morning. Seeing ~15-20% regression in P95 token latency vs last week. Renewal in 6 weeks, want proactive ops plan.

maria_cs: Oh no. Any obvious root cause?

ajenkins: Dashboard shows longer prompt lengths and higher concurrency during the spike. Hypothesis: KV cache hit rate dropped which increased batch pressure. Recommend targeted canary: int8 compact + routing tweak + prefix caching.

junaid_csm: Sample trace: "req=2023-06-12T10:02Z p95=420ms tokens=620 model=redwood-v2-8b". Agree.

sam_devops: Proposed actions: 1) spin up redwood-v2-8b-int8 as a canary slot, 2) route 5% traffic via route rule, 3) enable KV prefix caching for top templates, 4) add fallback if latency >600ms for 3m. Monitor semantic accuracy and token error rate closely.

leo_infra: KV cache policy: prefix_keys=["sablefield:q1_template","sablefield:q2_template"] TTL=12h. Also recommend per-request cache_enable=true on the route.

ajenkins: Cost estimate: int8 could reduce token unit cost ~30% for this workload if quality holds. I'll draft rollout steps, rollback criteria, and evaluation prompts.

maria_cs: Client cares about quality first. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with their PM + CSM tomorrow 11am PT and share the brief. We'll request an internal QA window.

sam_devops: Routing snippet for canary:
```
route: /v1/generate
canary: true
traffic_split:
  - model: redwood-v2-8b-int8
    weight: 0.05
  - model: redwood-v2-8b
    weight: 0.95
fallback_policy:
  - condition: latency>600ms for 180s
    action: route to redwood-v2-8b
metrics: [p50,p95,token_error_rate,semantic_accuracy]
```

deploy_bot: deploy_started: canary-slot redwood-v2-8b-int8 -> infra-canary-5pct at 4896543240

sam_devops: 30m update: canary p95 dropped from 420ms -> 365ms, token_error_rate unchanged, semantic accuracy stable on a 1k eval set. Continuing monitoring.

maria_cs: Great. I'll capture client QA feedback and escalate any subtle generation regressions. Owners: ajenkins (rollout doc), sam_devops (monitoring), maria_cs (client comms). Reconvene after 24h with metrics.

junaid_csm: Summary: canary int8 @5% + KV prefix caching + fallback rule. Client sync 11am PT. Proceed with caution and collect quality signals.
